def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(grid)
    # Locate the two nonzero markers outside the square frame.
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(n) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    left = min(markers, key=lambda x: x[1])[2]
    right = max(markers, key=lambda x: x[1])[2]

    # Fill the framed interior in opposing 2x2 quadrants.
    rows = [r for r in range(n) if all(grid[r][c] == 5 for c in range(2, 8))]
    top, bottom = rows[0], rows[-1]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(3, 7):
            out[r][c] = left if (r - top - 1 < (bottom - top - 1) / 2) == (c < 5) else right
    return out
